hypothesis: Completed-season outcomes contain a persistent pitcher command component after removing the difficulty explained by that historical pitch's TrackMan physics. A shrunk pitcher mean of control_success minus an out-of-sample physics-teacher probability can transfer better than either raw outcome level or target-free TrackMan profiles.

novelty_audit.v5_privileged_trackman_distill_c: aggregated physics_teacher and physics_teacher minus control_teacher, but never used realized control_success minus physics_teacher
novelty_audit.v5_lupi_hybrid_denoising: changed row-level training targets, but did not form a completed-history pitcher residual profile
novelty_audit.v3_e14: uses historical outcomes without conditioning on the realized historical pitch physics

data_contract.residual_source_cutoff: season strictly before the validation season
data_contract.deployment_feature: frozen completed-season pitcher residual table plus current row pitcher_id

physics_teacher.2019_prediction: deterministic five-fold GroupKFold out-of-fold prediction with pitcher_id as the grouping key and never as a model feature
physics_teacher.2020_prediction: strictly out-of-time teacher fit on 2019 and scored on 2020; reuse the immutable v5_trackman_teacher_scores_dev artifact

residual_profile.season_centering: subtract the matched-R source-season mean residual
residual_profile.smoothing: sum of centered residual divided by matched row count plus k

source_grid.application: on R rows only, clip exact-C plus gamma times the frozen pitcher profile to [0.000001, 0.999999]; preserve exact-C on F
selection_order: maximum minimum full-score gain across 2020 and 2021
maximum minimum R-score gain across 2020 and 2021
smaller gamma, larger k, all-history window

source_gate.on_pass: freeze one recipe before 2022 and 2023 development
